capabilities: : Sync task status back to Google
extras: Requires manual setup of Google Cloud OAuth client. Advises using 'Create conflict file' for Obsidian Sync.
intentEvidence: Sync Google Calendar and Tasks into Obsidian daily notes as normal markdown rows.
motivation: It is convenient to see all scheduled meetings and tasks in Obsidian instead of checking two separate places daily.
problem: The need to check multiple separate applications (Google Calendar, Google Tasks) to view scheduled events and manage tasks.
summary: Sync Google Calendar events and Google Tasks into Obsidian daily notes using standard markdown rows.
